name: Tricksters of Cosi
description: Merfolk devotees of Cosi who are skeptical of gods and follow Kiora's story.

timeline.summary: Kiora descends from Sea Gate on an octopus tentacle to rejoin her own army of tricksters and sea monsters after the other planeswalkers dismiss her.
timeline.quote: five of Cosi's own tricksters and a legion of sea monsters.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells the tricksters Ulamog is coming and that the other planeswalkers plan to trap him, while she plans to kill or drive him away.
timeline.quote: Our plan is to kill him if we can, and drive him off if we can't,

relations.note: The tricksters are devoted to the faith of Cosi.
relations.quote: We who have kept the faith of Cosi know that there's nothing special about gods.

pages_say.description: Merfolk devotees of Cosi who are skeptical of gods and follow Kiora's story.
